newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai in Indonesia power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai in Indonesia power plant deal.

text.p: Hyundai Engineering Co, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, said on Monday it and two foreign firms had jointly won a $106.6 million contract from Amoseas Indonesia Inc to build a thermal power plant in Indonesia.
Hyundai said in a statement it had formed a consortium with Stone and Webster Engineering Co of the United States and Kanematsu Corp of Japan to bid for the deal.
Hyundai will be responsible for the construction of the plant's transformer substation on a turn-key basis.
The 156-megawatt geothermal power plant will be constructed in West Java by the end of November 1998, the statement said.
Geothermal power plants, first commercialised in the early 1990s in Italy, use natural heat obtained from the ground and produce no environmental pollution, the statement said.
